verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents first-party initiative-level tracking. It supports goals/objectives that connect projects, Epics visualized on a Roadmap, and projects mapped across teams with communicated health status and target dates. That covers the status part of the story and loosely implies team association. missing for 10: an explicit priority attribute on initiatives/epics, an explicit owning-team field or assignment, in-depth docs on the initiative data model, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Map out projects across teams, track work from people and agents in one place, communicate health status, and share target dates.
Create goals, align teams, and connect individual projects to company objectives.
